activity.notes: Ivan IV became Grand Prince of Moscow in 1533 and retained that title until his coronation as the first Tsar of Russia in 1547. ATLAS separates this Muscovite grand-princely reign from the existing 1547-1584 Tsardom of Russia Activity.

sources.title: Ivan IV Vasilyevich the Terrible — Moscow Kremlin Museums
sources.citation_text: The Moscow Kremlin Museums biography identifies Ivan IV as Grand Prince of Moscow from 1533 to 1547 and Tsar from 1547 to 1584.
